hypothesis: Archetype: common-case split plus control-flow lifting. PyImport_ImportModuleLevelObject() still carries generic fromlist/dotted-name post-processing even after the dominant absolute no-fromlist no-dot import path has already produced the module. A narrow early return for that shape may reduce repeated import-statement overhead on both cache-hit and cached-submodule paths without changing import semantics.
